items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: But it wasn't with Jethro then, we made them, not with some of the numbers, we made in New York with Melrose, see?

ctx.x: He played. Remember anything about that, whether those records were made, they were right here in Chicago, wasn't it? Yeah, all the records were made, they were right here in Chicago.

And most of all, outside the door we made in New York with Fatten and the banjo player, we made them, we went to New York and made them. But it wasn't with Jethro then, we made them, not with some of the numbers, we made in New York with Melrose, see? Melrose. Let's see, yeah, Melrose, we made most of, a lot of those numbers with Melrose. I wish I could get a good number and put on the records, you know, to show them trombone and play it hard to play. Yeah, I wish you could too. Yeah. I'm going to get together…
